name: fn2
description: Start, monitor, and schedule FN2 AI autonomous research agents for public markets from your terminal assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Launch and schedule FN2 AI market research agents
interface.longDescription: Drive the public fn2.ai API to start research agents, check their status and latest results, and schedule them on a cadence such as 'before the next market open'. Dependency-free Python 3 helper; connects via a browser device-authorization flow (fn2.ai/start) with a scoped, revocable credential.
defaultPrompt: Use $fn2 to show the status of my fn2 agents.
Use $fn2 to schedule a pre-market brief on my watchlist before the next market open.
